# `worker` environment variables

Every variable `worker` uses, declared in `libs/application-generic/src/config/env.schema.ts` (shared) and `apps/worker/src/config/env.ts`.

- **Boot**: what `validateEnv` checks when `worker` starts. A required variable must be set; a checked one must match its format when set. Variables with no rule are not checked.
- **Read by**: the code that reads the variable, found by scanning `worker` and the workspace packages it depends on, plus the SDKs listed in `readBy`.
- Feature flags (`FeatureFlagsKeysEnum` in `@novu/shared`) and other families read by a computed name are described in the schema headers instead.

To regenerate after changing a schema or a read, run the spec with `UPDATE_ENV_REFERENCE=true`. Enterprise readers refresh whenever the file is regenerated with `.source` checked out, but they alone never make it stale: `.source` bumps don't run the app specs.
